title: What to check before replace all?
hook: A broad replacement can change matches you did not mean to touch.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that replace all changes every exact match, including ones you did not intend, so previewing the matches first catches mistakes

misconception: Replace all changes only the matches you meant.
objective: Inspect every exact-match replacement before applying it.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: A broad replacement can change matches you did not mean to touch. What should a broad edit preview expose? Correct option: All affected matches. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

claims.text: The preview marks every exact match. The applied edit changes each marked token, making its scope inspectable; it does not determine whether the replacement was appropriate.
